svg.title: Why triplen harmonics add up in the neutral
svg.desc: Left panel: the fundamental currents of phases L1, L2 and L3 are 120 degrees apart and sum to zero, so the neutral carries nothing. Right panel: their third harmonics are all in step, because three times 120 degrees is a full turn, so in the neutral they add to a wave three times as large.

svg.text: 120° apart: the three currents cancel, neutral = 0
